why: MI-280, an UNFORESEEN BLOCKER found while driving this lane's own PRs, filed as a first-class item the way the manager checklist says to. Tier-1: scripts/ci/**, .github/workflows/pytest-run.yml and the health backlog. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path. pytest-run.yml is NOT LANDING_MACHINERY — verified against origin/main by parsing the literal (12 entries; the twelfth is {APPROVAL_DIR}/**, an f-string an earlier count of mine missed and reported as 11). WHAT IT FIXES: a green pytest-run reports `N skipped` and nothing about which N, so a whole module going dark under one module-level skipif reads identically to routine conditional coverage. The data already existed — pytest-run writes --junitxml and parses it for FAILURES only — so this reads the same file under if: always(), costing no runtime and no dependency, and is continue-on-error because an observability bug must not redden a green suite. WHAT IT DOES NOT FIX, and the PR says so rather than implying otherwise: whether tests/test_automerge_request_gate.py (the whole suite for check_automerge_trigger.py, which IS landing machinery) is actually being skipped in CI. I could not establish it — no control run survives, 50+ other modules skip conditionally, and no log echoes a PATH — and that ambiguity is precisely the defect being fixed. One of my own inferences on the way was unsound and is recorded as such: I compared 14 tests against 14 skips across branches carrying DIFFERENT versions of the file (7 vs 14). THE BAR IS MET AND THE INTERESTING PART IS THAT I FAILED IT FIRST: the first implementation collapsed every module in the repo into `tests`, passed a hand-written fixture that set a `file=` attribute real pytest does not emit, and failed on the first REAL report. The self-test now generates every report by RUNNING pytest, because a fixture that does not reproduce the producer is a second implementation of the thing under test — and mine agreed with the bug. 7 planted defects, 7 caught, P1 being that exact collapse; positive control quiet on restore. REGISTERED AS A SELF-TEST ONLY AND LABELLED AS SUCH: the summariser needs pytest-run's JUnit report, which does not exist at guard time, so a green guard is not evidence the step works. The backlog row refuses to close on a passing self-test and demands an OBSERVED job summary on a green run.
